text: Which account was the lamp delivery at door 6, Pellow or Pellucid? Kwame and I went round on this in February.
reply_text:
The lamp delivery at door 6 was Pellow (Pellow Home Living), not Pellucid. I replied in the thread in #coastal-team.

The answer comes from the 17 Feb thread in that channel. Kwame said your retail account was the one showing the lamp delivery at door 6, not the container pickup, and you agreed. The container pickup rows are the Gulf Coast terminal ones, which belong to Pellucid Harbor Logistics.
